title: wkagent-name-tool howto
desc: T2 howto for wkagent-name-tool: invocation, PATH install, resolution order, hook integration, stats output.
steps: INVOKE (pace-safe): call the bare wk-prefixed command. In PowerShell or cmd the extension is optional via PATHEXT (wkagent-name). In bash you MUST append the extension (wkagent-name.cmd) because bash ignores PATHEXT, and a bare .ps1 will NOT run in bash. The wk-prefix is what makes it pace-exempt. NEVER call it by absolute path (the drive-letter tools wkagent-name.ps1 form is not wk-prefixed and gets pace-blocked when over budget).

INSTALL to PATH: copy a thin shim wkagent-name.cmd into the WillKim bin (find it with Split-Path of Get-Command wkappbot Source Parent). The shim forwards to tools wkagent-name.ps1 which dot-sources wkharness-agent-name.ps1 from its own dir, so the .ps1 must stay in tools. Prefer copy or shim over symlink (symlink needs admin). The grander design registers via the wkwrap resolver plus a wkdoctor-created bin symlink.

RESOLUTION ORDER (Get-WkCommitterModel in wkharness-agent-name.ps1): first env WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL, then the Win32 process parent chain for a model flag in an ancestor cmdline, then the active-session per-slug json fallback within an 8 hour window. Returns a model id, or ROOT (no model anywhere, treat as human), or UNKNOWN (CIM failure, fail-open).

HOOK INTEGRATION: githooks lib detect-model.sh calls wkagent-name first, then process lineage, then the subagent-active mark, then the active-session tracker, then a JSONL scan. pre-push allows opus and ROOT and empty, blocks a positively-identified cheap model. commit-msg appends a Model trailer. All three share detect-model.sh for DRY agreement.

STATS OUTPUT: stdout is the current model id only. stderr line 1 is the current process stats (pid cpu mem uptime plus truncated cmdline). stderr line 2 and beyond are ancestor AI processes prefixed with a caret and their model.

Exact match wins outright; falls back to the existing time-join when SessionId is empty or its jsonl is absent.
